node:zlib.callablePolicy: Existing six synchronous byte-only codec calls retain identity and policy. Gzip/Deflate constructors and factories provide the selected ordinary-only native Transform subset; remaining27 callables explicitly refuse call/new. No public backend hook.
supportedStatic: createGzip / Gzip: ordinary deployed persistent compressor Transform
createDeflate / Deflate: ordinary deployed persistent compressor Transform
deviations: Byte-only fixed attached unshared ArrayBuffer/view inputs; strings/shared/resizable/detached data refused.
Options only undefined or ordinary own-data maxOutputLength, integer1..16MiB. Unknown keys/symbols/accessors/prototypes explicitly refused; arbitrary Proxy reflection outside contract.
Six synchronous decoders retain exactly-one-member/trailing-data/dictionary policy. New streaming is encoding-only; streaming raw/decoder/Brotli/CRC and async one-shot functions remain deferred.

constants.ZLIB_VERNUM and legacy default.ZLIB_VERNUM use the same native header numeric value only after linked zlibVersion() matches; actual guest value remains unverified. Node baseline4865 is not fabricated for a different codec.

The profile freezes its default/constants/codes and uses null-prototype constants/codes. Pinned Node22 also freezes codes; that alone is not a deviation. Other Node descriptor/prototype/mutability comparisons require separate evidence. Z_MAX_CHUNK remains numeric Infinity.
Native staging/codec buffers and JS output are distinct allocator owners; output cap is not a peak-memory bound. GC/Node error-coercion/target behavior remain unproved.

Error-semantics proposal: only Z_DATA_ERROR, Z_BUF_ERROR and Z_NEED_DICT carry numeric codec errno; profile limits/refusals/backend/internal errors omit errno. Dictionary-required input throws Z_NEED_DICT without enabling dictionaries. Six errno-only and one dictionary-code ledger differences are targeted; 15 other recorded differences remain explicit and unapproved. Error messages/descriptors are not claimed fully Node-identical.
Streaming requires explicit NODE_COMPAT_ZLIB_STREAMING +classic/ticks, is deployed-only, and uses selected guest codec, not web CompressionStream or a host codec.
Streaming fixed64KiB staging,64MiB cumulative input,80MiB output,16 live handles,65536 deflate steps. Stream chunkSize64..65536 and inherited bounded Buffer/classic queue limits remain.

Selected stream options: level,windowBits,memLevel,strategy,chunkSize,highWaterMark/readableHighWaterMark/writableHighWaterMark; defaults flush0/finishFlush4 only; dictionary/objectmode/overrides/params/reset deferred. Unrelated Next threshold/filter data options ignored.
Public flush supports Z_NO_FLUSH/Z_SYNC_FLUSH/Z_FULL_FLUSH, default FULL; FINISH is private finalization only. No streaming decoders/raw/Brotli or async one-shot callbacks added.
Complete compressed-byte Node comparisons are HOST-only same-backend observations; selected guest1.3.1 header versus host1.3.0.1 remains explicit.
